Oil (last traded Friday 7 Aug 2026 — markets closed over the weekend):
- Bloomberg market wrap: West Texas Intermediate rose above $78 a barrel after surging almost 3% the previous session; Brent settled around $82.
- Brent futures on Friday 7 Aug closed near $82/bbl (TradingEconomics reference level $82.15, -0.41% on the day). Brent climbed more than $1 intraday Friday on Hormuz/Iran uncertainty before easing.
- No fresh oil print for Saturday 8 Aug (weekend). The Saturday ADNOC tanker missile strike and Gulf condemnations occurred with markets shut; price reaction, if any, will register at Sunday/Monday reopen.
- Context: Trump's repeated "deal is close" signals this week drove oil lower and stocks higher midweek; no deal materialised.
